definitions.explanation: A word or phrase that someone habitually uses, often without realizing it.

examples.japanese: 「まあ」が{彼女|かのじょ}の{口癖|くちぐせ}だ。
{父|ちち}の{口癖|くちぐせ}は「{努力|どりょく}あるのみ」だ。
examples.english: My father's catchphrase is "Only through effort."

examples.japanese: 「えーと」が{口癖|くちぐせ}になっている。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{口|くち} (mouth) + {癖|くせ} (habit) → mouth habit = verbal habit

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・〜が{口癖|くちぐせ}だ - "..." is someone's catchphrase
・{口癖|くちぐせ}になっている - has become a verbal habit
・{口癖|くちぐせ}のように{言|い}う - to say as if it's one's catchphrase

COMMON EXAMPLES OF {口癖|くちぐせ}:
・「まあ」「えーと」「{要|よう}するに」「ていうか」「つまり」

RELATED:
・{癖|くせ} - habit (general)
・{寝癖|ねぐせ} - bed head (hair habit)
